Hi Storm

Thunderbird can use your default Android contacts app to retrieve email addresses. To enable this..,

1. Add one or more names and their email address into your contacts app.

2. Long press the launcher icon and tap "app info".     If this is not available, navigate to android settings > apps > tap Thunderbird

3. Tap permissions and grant access to contacts

4. Open a compose or reply screen, tap the three dot menu (top right) > Add from contacts

There's some additional options when using contacts in the app settings. Navigate to settings > general settings > display.

  1. Show contact name
  2. Show contact pictures
  3. Colourise contacts
